_comment: Classification of every key of PLAN_LIMITS (apps/api/src/modules/billing/domain/enums/index.ts). scripts/generate.mjs fails if PLAN_LIMITS gains a key that is not listed here, so the enforcement question is asked the first time someone adds a limit. Only keys under `enforced` reach the public reference page. Re-verified 2026-09-21.

maxApiKeys.label: Active API keys
maxApiKeys.note: Counts active keys; revoked keys do not count.

maxScopesPerKey.label: Scopes per key
maxScopesPerKey.note: Checked when a key is created and when its scopes are changed.

prodKeysAllowed.label: Production (PROD) keys
prodKeysAllowed.note: Free accounts can only create DEV keys.

notEnforced.maxAgents: Declared per plan, but the hub applies a single limit (PLAN_AGENT_LIMITS.PRO) to every account; see the flat limits table.
notEnforced.maxMembers: CheckPlanLimitsService exists but nothing calls it when members are added.
notEnforced.customDomains: No enforcement site; no custom-domain feature exists.
notEnforced.rateLimitPerMinute: Only checked for TunnelClient (WebSocket SDK) requests, and only while the key's cache entry still holds the plan value (5 minutes); agents and the tunnel URL are never rate limited. See docs decision 2026-09-21.
notEnforced.allowedEnvironments: Unused; prodKeysAllowed is what is checked.
notEnforced.expiryAllowed: No enforcement site; the dashboard lets any plan set an expiry date.
